contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17. Flan lacks legends on both sides. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Two soldiers facing each other with one standard between them; the prominent vexillum, set above at least two discs, bears a Chi-Rho. Reverse inscription: GLO[RIA…
